## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The second of [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC)'s three *yīnmíng* works (with [KR6o0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0018) and [KR6o0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0022)), this one *juǎn* offers a thematic digest of the most important interpretive points of the *Yīnmíng rù zhèng lǐ lùn* [KR6o0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0003), compiled (*jí* 集) rather than composed in linear-commentary form. It opens by surveying five distinct interpretations (五釋) of the title-words *yīnmíng* found in earlier commentators, and proceeds to systematize the doctrine of the three causal-types (生因 productive, 了因 cognitive, 智因 intellectual) and the four sub-types of perception and inference. The work functions as a reference compendium intended to guide readers through the *Rù lùn* and Kuījī's *Dàshū* by topic rather than by passage, and is therefore especially useful for navigating disputed-question discussions.

**Abstract**

The colophon "淄洲大雲寺沙門慧沼集" credits Huìzhǎo of the Dàyúnsì 大雲寺 in Zīzhōu 淄洲 as compiler. The work appears to have been written together with the *Yìduàn* [KR6o0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0018) in the same period of Huìzhǎo's mature exegetical activity (c. 690–714); modern scholarship treats them as a paired set, with the *Yìduàn* taking the form of disputed-question arbitration and the *Zuǎnyào* taking the form of topical synthesis. The *Zuǎnyào* is more selective than the *Yìduàn*: it concentrates on the interpretive cruxes that govern the structure of *yīnmíng* doctrine, especially the analyses of *parārtha* and *svārtha* operations and the canonical four-fold typology of contradiction (四相違). Internal evidence shows that Huìzhǎo regards Kuījī's *Dàshū* [KR6o0008](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0008) as the orthodox standard but is willing to depart from it on a small number of points where he claims to recover Xuánzàng's own oral teaching. The Taishō follows the Korean canon as base text, collated against the 甲 and 原 manuscripts.
